# Alpine Engineering

> Software companies that grew on referrals get the attention their good work deserves, from the prospects who don't know them yet.

Alpine Engineering (Alpine LTD) was founded in 2024 by Stanislav Petrov, who has built software since 2015. What a software company's owner already says about their work becomes their presence on every platform their prospects use, in their own words and under their own name. The company keeps it to three owners at a time. The site is one page in English.

## The page

- [What it is](https://alpine-engineering.eu/#what): This is for you if you believe that sharing what you solved, and what failed, helps the next person in your shoes, and that this is how a prospect comes to trust you.
- [How it works](https://alpine-engineering.eu/#how): Prospects come to know you and trust you before the first call, while your own time stays on your clients and you keep the final say on every word that carries your name.
- [Our record](https://alpine-engineering.eu/#record): AI assistants for a Big Four company (Google Vertex AI, Python); cloud infrastructure and platform for one of Europe's biggest retailers (FastAPI, Go, Kubernetes); a vibe-coded platform for teachers moved onto properly built software (Django, AWS).
- [Free help](https://alpine-engineering.eu/#free): We share what we learn about reaching prospects who don't know you yet, and all of it is free to use, whether we ever work together or not.
- [Free roadmap](https://alpine-engineering.eu/#roadmap): Answer eight quick questions, and you'll see which of the five stages you're at and the exact steps that move you to the next one. The roadmap itself: https://alpine-engineering.eu/roadmap.html
- [See if you're a fit](https://alpine-engineering.eu/#ask): Before anything starts, we have a short call to see if this fits you, because it only works when it feels like yours.
- [About us](https://alpine-engineering.eu/#about): We built this company because sharing what you know is the one free way left to earn attention, and when you keep showing up, that presence grows until the right people already know and trust you.
